claims: Paris–Roubaix is a 260km one-day professional cycling Monument in northern France.
Paris–Roubaix is often pronounced Pah-ree Roo-bay.
Paris–Roubaix is known as the Hell of the North.
Paris–Roubaix is held annually in April.
Paris–Roubaix features elite men's and women's races.
Paris–Roubaix races finish in the Roubaix Velodrome.
Wout van Aert won the 2026 edition of Paris–Roubaix.
The men's race of the 2026 Paris–Roubaix was on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Paris–Roubaix features roughly 56km of cobbled roads.
Arenberg Forest is a major sector in Paris–Roubaix.
Tadej Pogačar raced a Colnago V4Rs on 38mm Continental tyres and a 1x drivetrain in the 2026 Paris–Roubaix.
Tadej Pogačar finished second in the 2026 Paris–Roubaix.
Barry-Roubaix is a gravel event in Michigan.
